R341.note: exec() replaced with a direct raw-socket WHOIS client plus strict domain allowlist; closes injection at the root, referral-chasing preserves functional parity and is disclosed.

R342.note: Tika magic-byte detection replaces the trusted Content-Type header and filenames are server-generated (UUID); PNG/JPEG uploads still succeed, no undisclosed side effects.

R343.note: moves attacker data out of the format-string position and HTML-encodes it; output shape change from arbitrary format-driven text to a fixed template is disclosed and was never a legitimate use case.

R344.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE on both fields at the body-text sink; correct context, no other change.

R345.note: Roslyn CSharpScript replaced with DynamicExpresso.Interpreter, reflection off by default, only Total/Tax exposed; Task<object?> contract and formula capability (e.g. Total*Tax/100) preserved.

R346.note: htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES) on the note value at the echo sink; clean, minimal, correctly scoped to the reported line.

R347.note: strict email allowlist regex blocks CR/LF before the RCPT TO line is built; added try/finally socket close is disclosed and only improves reliability.

R348.note: RFC 4515 hex-escaping of filter metacharacters before the uid clause is built; correctly closes filter injection without altering query shape.

R349.note: detailed error moved to server-side structured log, generic message to client, status code and success path left untouched.

R350.note: ESAPI encodeForLDAP escapes filter metacharacters before concatenation; matches existing codebase conventions, no behavior change beyond escaping.

R351.note: correct primary defense (4-arg parameterized DirContext.search with {0} placeholder), but the shown patch renames the `filter` variable to `filterExpr` without updating its other use at lines 88-93, so the file as patched would not compile; the write-up flags this but does not deliver the corrected snippet.

R352.note: strict filename allowlist plus explicit '..' check blocks CRLF/traversal before the RETR command is built; fail-closed, no side effects.

R353.note: htmlspecialchars at the single true HTML-body sink; correctly identifies ticketId as server-generated and untainted, scope of fix matches the actual taint.

R354.note: random/os.urandom reseed replaced with secrets.choice CSPRNG; alphabet and length unchanged, no other behavior change.

R355.note: server-side SORT_COLUMNS map correctly blocks identifier injection, but it renames the client-facing sort values (e.g. 'total' instead of the real column name 'total_cents' that the original code actually accepted); any caller previously sorting by the real column name now gets a thrown error, and this narrowing of accepted values isn't called out.

R356.note: rawComment escaped the same way authorName already is, at the one formatter that builds the HTML; matches existing pattern, no other change.

R357.note: moves the term out of pre-built markup into a Jinja2 {{ term }} placeholder so autoescaping applies; correctly diagnoses that baking data into template source bypasses autoescaping.

R358.note: variable-variable dispatch replaced with a static allowlist map to the two intended handlers; both original commands still work identically.

R359.note: printable-ASCII-no-whitespace allowlist on cacheKey blocks space/CR/LF field-delimiter injection before the command is built; signature and protocol framing unchanged.

R360.note: createCipher (unsalted MD5 KDF, deterministic IV) replaced with createCipheriv + scrypt + random IV + GCM; added salt/iv/authTag response fields are a necessary and disclosed consequence of fixing the sink correctly.

R361.note: removing the attacker-controlled decoder.Entity assignment correctly restores strict entity parsing, but the replacement behavior (unconditionally prepending label to Note) is not equivalent to the original entity-substitution semantics (which only applied where the document referenced the entity) - an observable output-shape change beyond the fix.

R362.note: Math.random replaced with crypto.randomBytes(16) base64url; still usable as Map key and JSON field, format change is an expected and disclosed consequence.

R363.note: adds IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync and UseAntiforgery() correctly in mechanism, but no token-issuing endpoint (e.g. GetAndStoreTokens) is added anywhere in the fix or noted as needed, so no legitimate client has any way to obtain a valid token - the endpoint becomes permanently unusable, and this is not disclosed.

R364.note: CR/LF and control-character stripping applied consistently to both the success and failure log lines; parameterized logging preserved, no other behavior change.

R365.note: extension allowlist + magic-byte verification + server-generated filename correctly close the upload vector, but a new 10MB size cap is added beyond the CWE-434 fix scope and would reject previously-legitimate larger uploads; disclosed but still a scope-creep behavior change.

R366.note: double-submit CSRF token (csrf-csrf) added with its own token-issuing endpoint gated by session auth, so legitimate callers have a working path to obtain and submit a token; existing origin check kept as defense-in-depth; wiring assumptions clearly disclosed.

R367.note: magic-byte allowlist plus server-generated filename closes the vector with no scope creep beyond the sink; response shape change (stored name) is a necessary, disclosed consequence.

R368.note: removing @csrf_exempt is the correct minimal fix and restores Django's existing CSRF machinery, but the write-up itself states existing templates/AJAX callers must now be updated to send the token - a disclosed, required follow-up that will break current callers until done.

R369.note: mt_rand + attacker-controlled seed replaced with random_bytes(32); client_seed dropped entirely, which was never a legitimate input to begin with.

R370.note: canonicalizes destination once and re-validates each entry's real parent directory after creation before copying through the resolved path, correctly closing the symlink TOCTOU gap the lexical normalize() check missed.

R372.note: fmt.Sprintf string-built query replaced with a parameterized placeholder query; driver-specific placeholder-syntax assumption is disclosed.

R373.note: detailed error logged server-side, generic message returned to client; status code changed 500->404 is disclosed and only affects the already-failing path, not success responses.
